peter: Capitalized Peter is a personal name; lowercase peter is also a verb meaning to diminish, so current proper-name gloss conflicts with case.
grassroot: The usual attributive form is grassroots; verify whether singular grassroot is intentionally included.
trans: Trans can be a shortened adjective for transgender and a prefix indicating across; current gloss conflates uses.
belate: Rare or obsolete verb; check attestation and whether to teach belated instead.
cal: Cal, cal, and Cal. have several readings; specify calorie versus other proper names and units.
centerist: Common spelling is centrist; centerist needs attestation as a variant.
coli: Appears predominantly in E. coli and scientific names; independent word-sense is questionable.
yuppy: Common spelling is yuppie; verify yuppy variant.
fro: Informal clipping of Afro for hairstyle; can be defined with register if retained.
unauthorize: Uncommon verb; distinguish revoke authorization from unauthorized adjective.
versa: Primarily occurs as part of vice versa, not a stand-alone equivalent of vice versa.
petit: Occurs in borrowed compounds such as petit four; standalone English entry is questionable.
summat: Dialect spelling meaning something; retain only if dialect coverage is desired.
mony: Scots form of many; retain only if Scots coverage is desired.
